node.title: Re: Trouble skipping lines using Perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
next if ($chromosome =~ /^chrM/);

You're very close, you just need to use the "[doc://perlop#Binding-Operators|binding operator]" =~ instead of = and your code works. See also [doc://perlrequick] and [doc://perlretut].

Note that if you're using [doc://warnings], which you should, you should have gotten a warning "Use of uninitialized value $_ in pattern match (m//)". See also [id://111088].

BTW, please enclose your sample input data in tags as well (not

).
